test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If Arun can complete 2/3rd of a work in 12 days, then in how many days can he complete 1/6th of the same work?
solution:
Given

A can do 2/3 of a work in 12 days.

Concept used

Time and work

Calculation

A does 2/3 of a work in 12

Whole work will be done

⇒ (3 × 12)/2

Total work = 18 unit

A does 1/6 of work in 

⇒ 18 × 1/6 = 3 days.

Hence, the correct answer is 3 days.
